message.content: I'll help you build a Jira MCP server in TypeScript. Let me first load the MCP builder skill to follow best practices.
message.reasoning:
The user wants to build an MCP server in TypeScript that wraps the Jira REST API so Claude can search and create tickets. This clearly matches the mcp-builder skill description: "Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK)."

I should load the mcp-builder skill first, then follow its instructions to help build this MCP server.
